en.headline: Police remind public of traffic measures for Northern Metropolis Marathon
en.dek: Special road closures and public transport adjustments will take effect from Friday to facilitate the event on Sunday, with early MTR services planned.
body: Police reminded the public on Thursday that crowd safety management measures and special traffic arrangements would be implemented from Friday to facilitate the Northern Metropolis Marathon 2026 on Sunday.

Temporary road closures will begin in phases from 2am on Sunday in areas including Shek Mun, Lung Shan Tunnel northbound and Fanling Bypass southbound. Roads are expected to reopen in stages, with On Lai Street area around 8am, Lung Shan Tunnel northbound by about 11am and Fanling Bypass southbound by about 3pm.

Several franchised bus routes and green minibuses will be diverted, truncated or suspended during the closures. MTR East Rail Line services between Hung Hom and Sheung Shui, and Tuen Ma Line between Tai Wai and Wu Kai Sha, will start earlier, with the first Hung Hom to Sheung Shui train departing at 4.20am.

Motorists travelling from Fanling Highway towards the Heung Yuen Wai Boundary Control Point will be diverted via Sha Tau Kok Road. The Transport Department and police urged the public to plan journeys in advance and use public transport where possible.

zh.headline: 警方提醒北部都會區馬拉松特別交通安排
zh.dek: 特別封路及公共交通調整將由周五起實施，以配合周日賽事，港鐵將提早開出首班車。
body: 警方周四提醒市民，為配合本周日舉行的北部都會區馬拉松2026，人流安全管理措施及特別交通安排將由周五起實施。
臨時封路將於周日凌晨2時起分階段在石門、龍山隧道北行及粉嶺繞道南行等地區展開。道路預計分階段重開，安麗街一帶約上午8時、龍山隧道北行約上午11時、粉嶺繞道南行約下午3時。
封路期間，多條專營巴士路線及專線小巴將改道、縮短或暫停服務。港鐵東鐵綫紅磡至上水及屯馬綫大圍至烏溪沙的首班車將提早開出，紅磡開往上水的首班車於上午4時20分開出。
由粉嶺公路前往香園圍邊境管制站的車輚將改經沙頭角公路。運輸署及警方呼籲市民及早規劃行程，盡量使用公共交通工具。
